metadata.description: Zettelkasten-style Agent Plugins wiki bundles. Cloudsmith is the artifact store; plugins/ vendors the latest package from it so stable Claude Code (which doesn't yet support the archive source type) can install directly from git.

plugins.name: rgh-sme
plugins.description: Zettelkasten-style LLM wikis across a set of subject-matter domains, built from reference texts and packaged as Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundles.

plugins.name: rgh-pre
plugins.description: Consumer wiki package for personal wellbeing and Personal Reliability Engineering: philosophy, mindset, telemetry-state, capacity-load, failure-modes, controls-design, incident-response, reliability-strategy.

plugins.name: bundle-curator
plugins.description: Harness-agnostic curation tooling for Zettelkasten-style OKF wiki bundles: skills, shared agents, and scripts to onboard sources, dispatch domain curators, review charters, and drain scoring/landscape backlogs. Domain-agnostic — reads domain slugs from the consuming repo's okf-core.toml. Mastered directly in this repo (not vendored from Cloudsmith).

plugins.name: rgh-mms
plugins.description: Development control-plane agent surface for Russell's Mini-me Swarm: planner/implementor/reviewer/approver/researcher agents, delivery/review/research skills, and the canonical policy/roles/workflows they follow, self-contained with a layered per-repo config resolver.
